notes.title: Blackout patch 1.1
notes.notes:
This is a small patch to fix some achievements issues and also add new ones.

- Achievement [b]Wanderer[/b] will no longer popup when you first play the game, but once you visit all locations.
- Achievement [b]Gallery[/b] is fixes. If you got all art pieces, just open the Gallery to get it.
- Achievement [b]All Endings[/b] is fixed. If you already got all 5 endings, you should get the achievement once you open the game.
- All chapter completion achievements were fixed, if you got 100% on any chapter, you should get the achievement when loading or starting a new game.
- Achievement [b]Praise the Lord[/b] now is also granted on two passages where you should get it previously. In case you have visited those passages, you will get the achievement once you load or start a game.
- Seven new achievements added for each Flashback in the game. If you got a flashback before, the achievements will pop up once you load or start a new game.
- Support for additional aspect ratios was added. If you have a super widescreen monitor you should be able to select your native resolution from the settings now.

notes.title: Blackout: The Darkest Night - Release
notes.notes:
Hello!

Blackout is finally available!

The game is 10% off for the first week! We have also added a deluxe edition DLC that contains the eBook version, twine files and a set of wallpapers! 

We have also added an FAQ post to our page if you are curious about how long the game is the replayability =)
